package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/workercontrol"
)

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	service, err := workercontrol.NewService(ctx, pool, workercontrol.Config{
		LeaseTTL:         2 * time.Minute,
		ActiveLeaseKeyID: "lease-key-v1",
		LeaseKeys: map[string][]byte{
			"lease-key-v1": []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"),
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	worker := workercontrol.AuthenticatedWorker{ID: uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_ID"))}
	candidate := workercontrol.AssignmentCandidate{
		JobID:                      uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_JOB_ID")),
		ExpectedJobVersion:         1,
		ExecutionProfileRevisionID: uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_PROFILE_REVISION_ID")),
	}
	assigned, err := service.Acquire(ctx, worker, 7, &candidate)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	replayed, err := service.Acquire(ctx, worker, 7, nil)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if assigned.AttemptID != replayed.AttemptID ||
		assigned.LeaseToken != replayed.LeaseToken ||
		!assigned.LeaseExpiresAt.Equal(replayed.LeaseExpiresAt) {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("N-1 replay changed durable Assignment: assigned=%#v replayed=%#v", assigned, replayed))
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		AttemptID uuid.UUID `json:"attempt_id"`
	}{AttemptID: assigned.AttemptID}); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
